items.title: ALERT: UPI Charges Are Coming - But Not for You. Here's What Actually Changes
items.summary:
Starting October 15, 2026, a 0.4% UPI MDR applies to specific merchant payments. Here is how this change impacts the market.

The new framework introduces a 0.4% fee for merchant payments over 2,000 rupees, though person-to-person transfers remain entirely free. Crucially, the government mandates that merchants cannot pass these costs onto customers, protecting the end user while ensuring the financial sustainability of the UPI ecosystem.

Only a small fraction of transactions—roughly 4%—are expected to be affected, as most payments fall below the threshold or qualify for exemptions. Essential sectors like fuel, telecom, and railways will see a flat 5-rupee fee for transactions over 2,000 rupees, rather than the percentage-based rate. This adjustment is designed to fund necessary infrastructure, cybersecurity, and the continued expansion of digital payments across India.

We break down how these transaction fees are structured, who covers the cost, and what this means for the broader financial landscape.

items.title: BREAKING: BharatGPT Challenges Larger Models in Epic AI Showdown
items.summary:
Bharat GPT is challenging industry leaders by outperforming Sarvam AI with only 2 billion parameters. See how it stacks up.

Corover.ai has entered the AI scale wars by claiming its new Bharat GPT Instruct model has surpassed Sarvam AI in performance benchmarks. Despite operating with 15 times fewer active parameters than its 30 billion parameter competitor, the model is positioning itself as a leader in the race for efficient, specialized systems.

This development highlights the growing focus on sovereign AI infrastructure within India, where local developers are prioritizing performance in regional languages over raw parameter size. As enterprises evaluate their generative AI strategies, this shift suggests that smaller, optimized models may soon rival the capabilities of massive, broad-scope systems in specific, high-value applications.

items.summary:
Make your coding agent interview you.

“Add login” leaves a lot unsaid: how long should sessions last, and should logging out end every session? I ask the agent to work through those choices with me before planning.

Try this prompt: “Before you plan, interview me about requirements, constraints and edge cases. Ask follow-up questions, then summarize our decisions for review.” #short
items.summary_html:

“Add login” leaves a lot unsaid: how long should sessions last, and should logging out end every session? I ask the agent to work through those choices with me before planning.

Try this prompt: “Before you plan, interview me about requirements, constraints and edge cases. Ask follow-up questions, then summarize our decisions for review.” #short

items.summary: In episode 1027 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. Dilani Kahawala, Co-Founder and CEO of Anna, about why building an AI assistant meant throwing away a decade of product thinking. She explains that most people still expect tap-and-dropdown menus rather than simply asking an agent to do things for them, and that consumers have little patience for an assistant that gets something wrong.

items.title: AI & Machine Learning: The Foundation Behind Every AI Solution
items.summary:
Every agent, language model and predictive system is built on the same foundation. Get this part right and the rest of the glossary is easier.

Terms covered:
- Artificial Intelligence: systems that learn, adapt and improve from data instead of following fixed rules written by a programmer
- Machine Learning: the mechanism, where a model learns to tell fraud from non-fraud by seeing thousands of examples
- Features: the variables and attributes that tell a model what to pay attention to
- GPU: the hardware that makes training viable on text, images and video, built for thousands of calculations running at once

AI sets the vision. Machine learning is the mechanism. Features are what the model learns from. GPUs are what make it scalable.

—
AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University

items.title: EXCLUSIVE: IBM Executive Says AI Made Developers Slower Before It Made Them 40 Percent Faster
items.summary:
New data reveals how AI coding tools impact developer speed. Learn why productivity results flipped from a 19% slowdown to an 18% gain.

In this episode of Front Page, Sudhi Sachdev sits down with Nagendra Bangalore, Director of Engineering for watsonx Orchestrate at IBM, whose PhD research examines the evolving relationship between humans and AI across personal and workplace settings. They discuss real-world developer productivity metrics using IBM Bob, maintaining critical thinking while leveraging AI coders, deploying agentic workflows across HR and procurement, building sovereign AI infrastructure with Yotta and Sarvam AI, and establishing evaluation guardrails for enterprise deployment. 

Less than a year later, a follow-up analysis showed a complete reversal, with developers recording an 18% speed increase. We analyze this shift in software engineering and what it means for how teams manage AI productivity in real-world environments.

CHAPTERS:
0:00 The AI Coding Paradox
1:41 Human-AI Relationships and Their Mechanisms
3:59 Defining the Boundaries of AI Dependency
8:05 Inside IBM's AI Coding Philosophy
16:05 Advice for the Next Generation of Engineers

items.title: DRDO Unveils Indigenous GaN Tech for Defence Radars | OpenAI Delays IPO to 2027 | Front Page
items.summary:
India's Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has successfully developed and demonstrated indigenous Gallium Nitride (GaN) semiconductor technology, producing a 3.5x3 mm chip delivering 30 watts at X-band frequencies. Operating up to 300 times faster than traditional silicon, this milestone severely reduces foreign dependence for next-generation radars, electronic warfare systems, and military jammers. Internationally, US President Trump called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang during the All-In Summit to dismiss AI safety concerns, while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman delayed the company's IPO to at least 2027 over safety risks. Meanwhile, PM Modi warned against technology weaponisation at the BRICS summit, Microsoft released an AI code of conduct, Dhruva Space signed a €5M contract with Safran for India's 52-satellite surveillance program, Google launched five climate AI initiatives in India, Pocket FM hit a $500M run rate, BRAHMA AI won a Tech Emmy, and Teleperformance CTO Amit Vohra joins us live.
